data.one_liner: Material color picker widget with customizable colors and shade selection for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a Material Color picker widget that allows users to select a main color and its shades, or custom colors. It also includes a CircleColor widget to display selected colors in settings or lists.
use_when: You need a color picker allowing users to select Material colors and their shades
You want to display a circular color preview widget inside app settings
avoid_when: You need advanced color picker formats like RGB, HSL sliders, or hex code text inputs
strengths: Supports custom color lists using ColorSwatch
Allows disabling shades to restrict selection to main colors only
Includes CircleColor widget for displaying selected colors
weaknesses: Limited to Material design colors and predefined swatches rather than full spectrum selection
Breaking change history with layout adjustments like shifting from GridView to Wrap

alternatives.name: flex_color_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a much more comprehensive color picker with extensive customization, multiple picker types, and color swatches.

alternatives.name: flutter_colorpicker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need various color picker layouts such as material, block, wheel, or square pickers.
